en: Sepia-toned early 20th‑century postcard showing a panoramic view of a spa town with grand multi‑story hotels and villas along a park or promenade in the foreground, backed by wooded hills. Leafless trees suggest late autumn or winter. The caption at the bottom left reads "Marienbad." and at the lower margin there is a printer's line mentioning Leopold Weil in Karlsbad and the year 1904.
